    • getAmount

      public BigInteger getAmount()
      Returns the amount of this destination in atomic units. For a conversion the meaning depends on where the destination comes from: on the transaction that createTxs or sweepUnlocked returns it is the source amount (in the source currency); in getTxs() after confirmation it is the destination amount (in the destination currency, from the core's dest_amount). The outgoing transfer's own amount stays the source amount.
      Returns:
      the amount in atomic units

    • setAmount

      public void setAmount(BigInteger amount)
      Sets the amount of this destination; on a send it is the amount in the source currency.
      Parameters:
      amount - is the amount in atomic units

    • getAssetType

      public String getAssetType()
      Returns the asset of this destination as the core reports it on transfers. On a send this field does not decide what is sent: the currency pair of the tx config (source and destination currency) holds for the whole transaction.
      Returns:
      the asset name (see ZephyrAssets), null if not reported

    • setAssetType

      public void setAssetType(String assetType)
      Sets the asset of this destination.
      Parameters:
      assetType - is the asset name (see ZephyrAssets)
